hooks.name: Kiro Workflow Post-Pipeline
hooks.description: After a security workflow sub-agent completes, emits a graph.completed event to trigger the RL loop (GT scoring, blockchain rewards, memory learnings) via the existing event subscription.

action.prompt:
SCOPE: This hook is ONLY for Kiro app-security workflow experiments (SAST, DAST, recon, sandbox-setup). If the sub-agent was dispatched for implementation, docs, QA, refactoring, or any non-security-workflow purpose — SKIP SILENTLY. Say nothing.

If this WAS a security workflow sub-agent:

1. Extract the run context from the sub-agent result (run_id, vuln_class, workflow_type, target_app, graph_id).

2. Emit a `graph.completed` event via companion-x:
   `call_brick_tool(brick_name="events", tool_name="events_publish", arguments={"event_type": "graph.completed", "source": "kiro.invokeSubAgent", "payload": {"run_id": "...", "vuln_class": "...", "workflow_type": "...", "target_app": "...", "graph_id": "...", "status": "completed"}})`

3. The existing event subscription (auto-rewards-workflow.yaml) will automatically:
   - Query graph for ProvenExploit entities
   - Score findings against ground truth
   - Mint blockchain rewards
   - Store learnings in memory

4. Say nothing else — the event-driven pipeline handles the rest.
